newsitem.title: USA: U.S. distillate production hits 3.8 mln bpd - EIA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. distillate production hits 3.8 mln bpd - EIA.

text.p: U.S. production of distillate -- heating oil and diesel -- reached an "extraordinary" 3.8 million barrels per day (bpd) last week, the Energy Information Administration said Wednesday.

The strong production, including a record high of 1.9 million bpd from Gulf Coast refineries, combined with lower demand helped boost total U.S. distillate stocks by 3.7 million barrels to 115.0 million barrels.
However, total inventories as of October 25 remained 16 million barrels below normal and 12.5 percent less than a year ago, EIA said in its weekly distillate watch.
Although stocks were moving from the Gulf Coast to the Northeast, which consumes the most heating oil, "stocks in PADD I (East Coast) remain an issue of concern," EIA said.
As of last Friday, stocks in the New England and Central Atlantic states on the East Coast at 30 million barrels stood 40 percent below last year's level.
